GPS next-stop announcements

Stop locations are built into the simulator. GPS stays active while the bus is moving or stopped. It automatically changes to Bus stopped and plays the stop announcement when a stop is detected, then changes back to Bus moving once the GPS detects at least 2 metres of movement away from that stop.

Allow location tracking?

The simulator can use this phone’s location to detect nearby Route 16 stops and play the matching announcement. Your location is processed in this browser and is not uploaded or stored by this simulator. You can stop tracking at any time.

Additional stop information

Route stop list

Select Keresley Village or City Centre above to show the stops in that direction. Direction-specific stops are included automatically, and the termini are marked.

Terminus sequence

The final stop in the selected journey direction is used automatically as the terminus. Choose NXC, NXWM or WMB for the thank-you recording. When the bus is stopped, only the stop-name recording plays; all additional stop-information messages are skipped. After that stop announcement finishes the simulator waits 2 seconds, then plays Amy 16 → Amy To → the selected destination. This repeats at every stop while the bus remains stopped. Switching back to Moving cancels a pending sequence. The last-stop button plays the shared last-stop message, then the matching operator thank-you recording. NXC and NXWM use their shared last-stop message and chime; WMB uses its own last-stop message and thank-you recording. It does not play Amy Next Stop or a stop-name recording.

Offline simulator. Audio plays from the included files. Location is used only after you allow it; this simulator does not upload or store your location. Audio recordings are embedded in this HTML file for reliable Android playback. For GPS, open this page over HTTPS on your phone.
